text:
maya: us-west1 pool-7 p90 spike just now, noticed sudden NVMe tail and NIC tx queues. ops-bot raised an alert.
sam: seeing p99 hop from 1.9s -> 5.6s for embeddings. suspect multi-tenant IO burst.
li: can we apply short egress cap and bounce the tenant's worker to break the IO pattern? which tenant id is hot?
maya: tenant id is ml-ingest-42. logs: [2025-03-02T04:12:10Z] host-rack21 nic_tx_full=980 nvme_wait=72 io_ops=3900 alloc=pool-7 tenant=ml-ingest-42
sam: propose quick mitigation: rctl route patch --pool pool-7 --soft_affinity 0.5 --fallback pool-dedicated-temp --ttl 6h and throttle egress to 40mbit. I'll put canary 15% first.
ops-bot: incident INC-20250302-0142 created, sev=3, assignee=@sam
